name: List Sync
description: Windows MDM settings in the List Sync category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Blocks syncing of external lists via Lists sync
properties.description: Enabling this setting prevents users at your organization from syncing lists that are shared from other organizations. After the setting is enabled (value 1) on a computer, lists shared from other organizations won't sync. Disable the setting (value 0) to allow your users to sync external lists.

properties.name: Disables Lists sync on this device.
properties.description: By default, Lists sync is turned on for users of Microsoft Lists. If you enable this policy, Lists sync will be blocked from running on the device.

properties.name: Disables silent configuration of Lists sync on this device.
properties.description: If you enable this setting, users at your organization will not be opted into Lists sync automatically. They will be required to install the Office web extension to use Nucleus.
